items.html:
Captain of the national side, Louis Burger is a solid middle-order batsman
who also bowls as first change for Namibia. He took over as captain from
Deon Kotze in 2006 and has been in sizzling form since, scoring two
first-class centuries, the biggest of which was 120 as his side demolished
the United Arab Emirates inside two days in the 2006/2007 Intercontinental
Cup.

He played all six of Namibia's matches in the 2003 World Cup and although he
had a nightmare with the bat - his top-score was 5 - he did dismiss
Matthew Hayden, Michael Bevan and Ricky Ponting on his way to figures of 3
for 39 against Australia.

stories.title: Burger's Namibia humble UAE
stories.subTitle: Namibia v UAE, ICC World Cup Qualifiers, Pretoria
stories.summary: With Afghanistan shocking Ireland by one wicket and Canada beating Kenya, Namibia  - winless and bottom of the table - managed to upset UAE who before today were happily placed in fifth position of the ICC World Cup Qualifiers
